Package domain.controller.solvingAlgorithm

Class SolvingAlgorithm

java.lang.Object
domain.controller.solvingAlgorithm.SolvingAlgorithm
Direct Known Subclasses:
Backtraquing
public abstract class SolvingAlgorithm extends Object
Abstract base class for Hidato solving algorithms. Concrete implementations of this class must provide the core solving behaviors: detecting whether a puzzle has any solution, validating whether a given Hidato represents a complete valid solution, and producing a GameSession representing the solved puzzle. *
